experimental_reality.raw_vs_task_level_interpretation: The evidence invalidates the assumption that raw TensorRT Level B failure alone proves final detection-task failure. It does not invalidate raw Level B as a numerical correctness gate or permit silently changing that gate.

plan_analysis.reason: The frozen plan treats raw K5 correctness as the prerequisite for downstream execution, while the independent 16-image task-level evidence shows stable final detections despite raw FP16 drift. Accuracy on the real validation set is still unmeasured, so a bounded task-level validation stage is required before any acceptance or integration decision.
recommended_flow: K5 raw correctness investigation (retain raw gate and failures)
temporary task-level validation addendum using real NEU-DET annotations
governance review and final plan update after measured dataset results
K6 application integration only after its formal prerequisites are satisfied
